parsed.post: New personal best: 0.870408! Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.025 combined with the global best stack seems to be the winning direction. It provides better convergence within the 5-minute budget than 0.03. Next, I will try to refine the LR even further to 0.02 to see if we can push below 0.870.
parsed.description: Decrease MATRIX_LR to 0.02 to see if even lower learning rates further improve convergence within the 5-minute budget.
